masteryZone.q: Which of the following is correct regarding Ohm's Law?
opts: V is inversely proportional to I
V is directly proportional to I
masteryZone.sol: According to Ohm's law, V = IR, so potential difference V is directly proportional to current I under constant physical conditions.

masteryZone.q: True or False: If two resistors are connected in series, the voltage across each resistor is always the same.
masteryZone.sol: False. In series, the current remains the same. The voltage is only the same if the resistors have equal values (V = IR).

masteryZone.q: The S.I. unit of electrical resistivity is ________.
masteryZone.sol: The resistivity ρ has the unit Ohm-meter (Ω·m).

sections.title: 2. Heating Effect, Electric Power & Domestic Circuits

masteryZone.q: The commercial unit of electrical energy (1 kWh) in Joules is:
True or False: An electric fuse must be connected in series with the live wire.
masteryZone.sol: True. Connecting it in series with the live wire ensures the circuit is completely broken if excessive current flows.

sections.title: 3. Magnetic Field Lines, Bar Magnet & Solenoids

masteryZone.q: Magnetic field lines inside a solenoid are:
opts: Curved lines merging at the center
masteryZone.sol: The magnetic field lines inside a solenoid are parallel straight lines, representing a uniform magnetic field.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Magnetic field lines always intersect at the poles.
masteryZone.sol: False. Magnetic field lines never intersect anywhere.

masteryZone.q: Which rule is used to determine the direction of induced current in a generator?
masteryZone.sol: Fleming's Right-hand Rule determines the direction of induced current (for generators), whereas Fleming's Left-hand Rule determines force (for motors).

masteryZone.q: True or False: An electric motor converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
masteryZone.sol: False. An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. A generator converts mechanical into electrical.
